"""RoboPaint trajectory for 臨帖 character 口 (eai-standard/2.2).

The running episode has already been inked and calibrated on the practice sheet.
Run this script once to write all three scored strokes; --start/--end allow
inspection between strokes on the live service. Pixels are target.png coordinates.
"""
import argparse
import math
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot

MM_PER_PX = 0.00022186
SHEET_FAR_X = 0.0135925
SHEET_LEFT_Y = 0.1135925
PARK = np.array([-0.1000, -0.1856, 0.22])

# Centerlines read from the exemplar's medial axis. A (u,v,z) triple uses
# image pixels and world height; z=0.020 is the main paper surface.
STROKES = {
    1: [
        (328,382,.012),(338,390,.012),(348,398,.012),(357,405,.012),
        (364,410,.012),(365,430,.012),(367,455,.012),(370,480,.012),
        (373,510,.012),(377,540,.012),(381,570,.012),(384,595,.012),
        (389,618,.012),(396,640,.012),(402,661,.012),
    ],
    2: [
        (367,410,.014),(390,408,.014),(420,404,.014),(450,399,.014),
        (480,394,.014),(510,388,.014),(540,383,.014),(570,377,.014),
        (600,371,.014),(618,368,.014),(630,367,.012),
        (640,369,.009),(650,376,.008),(660,385,.008),(669,400,.010),
        (667,412,.012),(663,430,.012),(658,455,.012),(652,480,.012),
        (647,505,.012),(642,530,.012),(637,555,.012),(633,578,.012),
        (629,598,.012),(628,610,.012),
    ],
    3: [
        (402,634,.012),(425,633,.012),(450,631,.012),(480,628,.012),
        (510,624,.012),(540,620,.012),(570,616,.012),(600,613,.012),
        (622,610,.012),(637,612,.012),(650,620,.012),
    ],
}


def paper_xyz(u, v, z):
    """Target pixel center -> world xyz; image left is +y, top is +x."""
    return np.array([
        SHEET_FAR_X - (v + 0.5) * MM_PER_PX,
        SHEET_LEFT_Y - (u + 0.5) * MM_PER_PX,
        z,
    ], dtype=float)


def arc_resample(points_xyz, speed, dt=0.05):
    """Sample a 3-D polyline at one target increment per 20 Hz frame."""
    p = np.asarray(points_xyz, dtype=float)
    lengths = np.linalg.norm(np.diff(p, axis=0), axis=1)
    cum = np.r_[0.0, np.cumsum(lengths)]
    total = float(cum[-1])
    if total < 1e-8:
        return p[-1:]
    n = max(1, int(math.ceil(total / (speed * dt))))
    s = np.linspace(min(speed*dt, total), total, n)
    out = np.column_stack([np.interp(s, cum, p[:, k]) for k in range(3)])
    return out


class Writer:
    def __init__(self, robot):
        self.r = robot
        now = np.asarray(robot.get_obs(video="none").meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
        self.q = now[10:14].copy()
        self.target = now[7:10].copy()
        self.actual = self.target.copy()
        print("starting tip", self.actual, "orientation", self.q)

    def send_xyz(self, goals, speed=0.08, dwell=0, note=""):
        """Stream a polyline of tip targets. The final target is held for dwell frames."""
        points = np.vstack([self.target, np.asarray(goals, dtype=float)])
        samples = arc_resample(points, speed)
        P = np.column_stack([samples, np.tile(self.q, (len(samples), 1))])
        res = self.r.submit("ee_pose", P, dt=0.05, video="none", cameras=["canvas_cam"], note=note)
        self.target = samples[-1].copy()
        self.actual = np.asarray(res.meta["proprio"]["now"][7:10], dtype=float)
        failures = sum(x.get("ik_failures", 0) for x in res.meta.get("plan", []))
        print(note or "move", "rows", len(samples), "ik_failures", failures,
              "target", self.target, "actual", self.actual)
        if dwell:
            P = np.tile(np.r_[self.target, self.q], (dwell, 1))
            res = self.r.submit("ee_pose", P, dt=0.05, video="none", cameras=["canvas_cam"], note=note+" settle")
            self.actual = np.asarray(res.meta["proprio"]["now"][7:10], dtype=float)
            print("settled", self.actual)
        return res

    def move_to(self, xyz, speed=0.08, dwell=4, note="approach"):
        return self.send_xyz([np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float)], speed=speed, dwell=dwell, note=note)

    def write_stroke(self, idx):
        raw = STROKES[idx]
        # Lower to this stroke's starting pressure above the current sheet.
        first = paper_xyz(*raw[0])
        high = first.copy(); high[2] = 0.065
        self.move_to(high, speed=0.10, dwell=4, note=f"stroke {idx} approach")
        self.move_to(first, speed=0.035, dwell=2, note=f"stroke {idx} contact")
        curve = np.array([paper_xyz(*p) for p in raw])
        res = self.send_xyz(curve[1:], speed=0.025, dwell=2, note=f"main stroke {idx}")
        # Break contact before moving to the next component.
        lifted = self.target.copy(); lifted[2] = 0.065
        res = self.move_to(lifted, speed=0.04, dwell=2, note=f"stroke {idx} lift")
        Path(f"/app/output/stroke{idx}").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        res.save(f"/app/output/stroke{idx}")
        return res

    def park_clear(self):
        # At z=.065 the brush is above the main sheet; then move to practice side.
        goal = PARK.copy()
        return self.move_to(goal, speed=0.10, dwell=6, note="park clear of main sheet")


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--start", type=int, default=1, help="first main stroke (1..3)")
    ap.add_argument("--end", type=int, default=3, help="last main stroke (1..3)")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    robot = Robot()
    writer = Writer(robot)
    for i in range(args.start, args.end + 1):
        res = writer.write_stroke(i)
        if i < args.end:
            # Clear the canvas view for inspection; travel begins after the lifted pose.
            writer.park_clear()
            obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=["canvas_cam"], video="none")
            from PIL import Image
            Image.fromarray(obs.last["canvas_cam"]).save(f"/app/output/after_stroke{i}.png")
    if args.end == 3:
        writer.park_clear()
    print("episode status", robot.status())

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
